stream_usage_ai_chat: stream AI chat responses about usage data via SSE events
create_chat_message: create a ChatMessage model with role and content fields for user or assistant
create_usage_ai_chat_request: create a UsageAIChatRequest with chat messages list and optional model name
call_usage_ai_chat_endpoint: call the POST /usage/ai/chat endpoint to chat about usage data with an AI agent
check_user_admin_view: check if a user API key has admin view access to usage data
